description: This file implements the Probe class and related functionality for a WPEFramework plugin, including discovery mechanisms, request handling, response creation, and network communication logic.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: A helper class representing discovery messages and responses, encapsulating various constructors for different discovery scenarios.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming network requests, manages discovery responses, and maintains state for the probe listener.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles incoming responses, validates them, and reports discovered devices with latency and model information.

methods.name: Probe::WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms incoming Web requests, specifically looking for M-SEARCH messages in SSDP discovery.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Listener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener, opening network ports, and joining a multicast group.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::~Listener
methods.description: Destructor closing network ports and leaving the multicast group.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Received
methods.description: Handles incoming SSDP M-SEARCH requests, validates them, and queues responses.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Send
methods.description: Handles sending responses and moving to the next destination.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in network channel state.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::ValidRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming discovery requests, including optional signature validation.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a SSDP response message with latency and model info.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming response data, validates, and reports discovered devices.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Records a discovered device with its URL, latency, model, and security status.
